description: A small clear plastic food container with gray side latches sits on a green-covered table in front of you. Both hands come in to steady the container as a two-hand object, then the left hand flips the left latch outward while the right hand flips the right latch outward and lifts the lid off as a right-hand object; the left hand reaches into the open container, removes a yellow item, and sets it down on the table while the right hand holds the lid to the side.
